en-US:
Version 2.0.1 - Easier for Everyone
• Improvements: Better TalkBack support, with a name on every button and easier-to-navigate cards • Improvements: Stronger contrast and larger touch targets • Improvements: Amounts and headings follow your system font size • Bug fixes: Search icon in dark mode and other small fixes • Thanks for using Caravella!
